note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Each guide is written for this entry in our own words; sources are cited beside every guide and never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks by itself once the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no extra task for it. Follow the roadmap in order: story, then stranger strands, then the open-world sweep. The last trophy you earn will most likely be a long counter (250 stunts, 100 vehicles, or 100% completion), so leave one quick trophy unfinished on purpose and let the Platinum land on a moment you choose.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission: play through its opening sequence, follow the prompts, and finish it. The trophy unlocks on completion. A failed step only restarts you at the last checkpoint, so it cannot be locked out.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's closing sequence. Before you finish the chapter, stop at the one missable step in the whole game — Lucia's balcony meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude — and meditate there first, or it is gone for this playthrough.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Play all of Chapter 2's missions through to the chapter-end sequence. By now the map has opened up a lot — a good moment to start the slow counters in passing (vehicles discovered, meditation spots, WAiNK It locations) instead of leaving all 100 of each for the endgame.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Complete the Chapter 3 mission set through its closing scene. Chapter 3 opens several side strands and activity types, so before moving on, try each activity type once — that also feeds Master of None — and clear any stranger missions that have appeared on the map.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the chapter close. This is the last chapter before the finale, so use it as a checkpoint: sweep up the partner co-op trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy and the remaining stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks before the endgame.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable, and the gold that closes the campaign. Play the final mission to its end and the trophy unlocks on completion. There is no mission replay, so finish any missables and anything you want to savour before starting the last mission; the open world stays available afterwards for the cleanup stages.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Breakfast Run is a story mission: start it from its marker, follow the objectives to the end, and the trophy unlocks on completion. Failing a step only restarts you at a checkpoint — it cannot be missed, only delayed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable. The Cartel Heist is a story mission — work through its objectives and finish it. Heist missions run long with several phases, so expect a few checkpoints; a failed phase restarts at the last checkpoint, not at the start of the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Child's Play is a story mission: complete it and the trophy follows. Remember that story missions count toward the 100% completion total for A Long Road — every mission trophy you earn is also progress toward that gold.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Headliners is a story mission: play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks. The mission is hidden on PlayStation until earned — keep the spoiler setting on if you would rather not know which missions carry trophies until you have played them.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable. VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around Vice City International Airport: finish it and the trophy pops. The same airport matters for Catch Me If You Can, the unscheduled-departure trophy — but that one is a separate free-roam stunt, not part of this mission, so do not try to force it here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable. Operation Savage Glory is a story mission: complete its objectives and the trophy unlocks. Like the other mission trophies it cannot be missed — a failed attempt returns you to a checkpoint inside the mission.

sources.name: How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real Platinum gate. 100% completion is a checklist the game itself tracks: story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the other counted totals all feed it. There is no shortcut — finish the story, all 8 stranger strands, the activity sets and the collectible sweeps, and the percentage climbs. Use the in-game stats page to see which category is still short, then work that category from this guide's roadmap. Expect this to be one of the last two trophies you earn.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: The longest grind in the list. A stunt is any trick the game scores while driving or riding — jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and the like — and the counter runs across the whole playthrough, so every stunt you pull from the first hour counts. The efficient route is a fast bike or car on a long straight with ramps: chain jumps and near misses, and revisit stunt-friendly spots rather than hunting one-offs. Most players finish the story at a fraction of 250, so budget a dedicated session for the remainder.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample the side activities: 9 types to try once each — racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities all count toward the set. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start and try one of each. Work through the activity icons on the map in the early chapters and this pops naturally; if one type is still missing late on, the in-game activity list shows which you have never touched.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The hardest skill trophy in the list. There are 42 Shooting Range challenges and every one needs a gold medal — not just a pass. Go in with the best weapon for each challenge type, learn the target patterns first with a few practice runs, and gold the short, easy challenges before the long ones so your aim is warm. The range lets you retry a challenge immediately, so a near-miss costs seconds, not a trip. Players call this the trophy that decides whether the Platinum takes 150 hours or 250, so leave it for a focused session.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida and you must win at each one. A win is first place in that location's race — you can retry a location as often as you like, and each win stays banked. Learn the course on a slow first lap, then race it properly: the drones handle on rails compared to cars, so the gains come from cutting corners and keeping speed through the gates rather than from raw pace. Work down the map location by location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. The race types are spread across the map: street races, off-road, boat and air events all count as long as each event is a distinct one. Pick the shortest races first and use the fastest vehicle in its class; a win in a race you have already won does not add to the 20, so move on to a new event each time.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal at a fishing spot and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are scored on the catch — size, rarity and speed all matter — so bring your best rod and bait for the species in that spot, and watch Cal's score before your final cast so you know the number to beat. You can retry the challenge, so a loss costs nothing but a little time.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. Arcade machines are scattered around Vice City's bars and arcades — sit down at one, play it out, and the trophy pops when the game completes. You do not need a high score, just a finished game, so pick the shortest machine you find and treat the rest as a diversion for later.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger contacts with a mission strand: work through his missions in order until his final one, complete it, and the trophy unlocks. Stranger strands appear as map icons as the story advances, so if Andy has not shown up yet, keep playing the story — the strand unlocks in its own time and cannot be rushed.

sources.name: How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is another stranger contact with his own mission strand. Finish every mission he gives you, in order, and complete his final one for the trophy. The strands are independent of each other, so you can clear Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone in any order — but each strand must be finished to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand works like the other stranger strands: take his missions as they appear, finish them in order, and complete his final mission for the trophy. Stranger missions are flagged on the map, and the game will tell you when a new one is available — check the map after each story chapter for new icons.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The stranger-strand silver. There are 8 mission strands given by strangers across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone among them — and you must complete all 8 to the end. Each strand is a chain of missions that unlocks as the story progresses, so the efficient route is to clear each strand as soon as its next mission appears instead of letting them pile up for the endgame. This silver is also a chunk of the 100% completion total, so it pulls double duty toward A Long Road.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is one of the 8 stranger strands: complete his missions in order and finish his final one for the trophy. Like the other strands it unlocks progressively — if Randy's next mission is not on the map yet, advance the story and check again.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is one of the 8 stranger strands: work through his missions and complete his final one for the trophy. Once all five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus the other three are done, Strangers & Freaks pops too — so this trophy is also a milestone on the way to that silver.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY — read this before Chapter 1 ends. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and the first is Lucia meditating on her balcony, offered only in Chapter 1. There is no mission replay, so if you finish Chapter 1 without meditating there, the trophy is locked for that playthrough. After that, the other 17 spots are open-world locations you can visit any time: approach a spot, meditate, and move on. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 as insurance, and tick each spot off in the tracker as you find it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted. Take the hunting gear, follow the tracking clues to the animal's territory, and bring it down — the trophy is about the specific unique animal Bret names, not about hunting in general. Approach quietly and use the right weapon for a clean kill; a spooked animal bolts and you will be tracking it again.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in packs and singles, and they belong to sets — complete 3 full sets for the silver. Cards are a pure exploration collectible: sweep an area thoroughly, check the usual hiding places (behind counters, on rooftops, in out-of-the-way corners), and use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are one or two cards short so you can target the gaps instead of wandering. Three sets is the trophy; finishing every set also feeds 100% completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the in-world tagging activity: find 100 WAiNK It locations across Leonida and tag each one. The spots are spread over the whole map, so this is a long sweep best done with a route — work district by district and mark each location in the tracker as you tag it, rather than criss-crossing the state. A location tagged once stays counted, so the total only ever goes up.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's small open-world objectives — the daily-style tasks and mini-feats listed in the challenges menu — and you need 50 completed. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so by the time the story is done you will already be part of the way there. For the rest, open the challenges list, pick the quickest ones (the short driving, shooting and collection tasks), and knock them out in batches rather than one at a time.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A co-op trophy: with your partner beside you, build up to a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is the escape, not the stars — get the wanted level in a quiet area with a fast car waiting, then break line of sight, switch vehicles if you can, and lie low until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement, so bring them along before you start causing trouble.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Another partner trophy, and a timing one: rob 3 shops in a row, back to back, with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level in between. Plan the route first — pick 3 shops close together on a quiet stretch, have a fast getaway car parked outside each one, and keep the robberies quick. If the wanted level drops to zero between shops, the chain breaks and you start over, so keep moving and keep the heat on.

sources.name: How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discovering a vehicle means encountering a new model for the first time — driving past one, seeing one parked, or finding one in traffic all count. There are far more than 100 models in the game, so this pops from normal play if you vary your driving: take different routes, visit different districts, and hop into anything unusual you see. The tracker in this guide counts toward 100 so you can see how close you are without opening the stats page.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: activate it with at least 5 enemies in front of you and take all 5 down before the meter runs out. Set it up rather than hoping for it — find a spot where enemies group up (a gang hangout or a shootout with several attackers), let them cluster, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly, headshots first. If you only get 4, the attempt does not count, so reload the checkpoint and try a busier spot.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — steal a plane and take off, or otherwise depart without going through the normal gates. The practical route is to get onto the tarmac, grab an aircraft, and get airborne; the trophy pops once you are away. Expect airport security and a wanted level on the way in, so go in fast and get out faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is about dealing with them — the exact trigger is one of the less-documented ones, and players are still pinning down whether it wants Rhinos destroyed, survived, or driven. The working account in the guides is that it pops from a tank encounter handled in free roam: provoke the military response, deal with the Rhinos that arrive, and it should unlock. If it does not pop on your first attempt, try the other reading (drive one yourself) before assuming it is bugged.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: get into a jewelry store, take the goods, and get out without any detection. Plan it like a quiet job — scout the store first, go at a quiet hour, move slowly, and avoid the sightlines of staff and cameras. If anyone spots you, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a better approach.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: The bank-job silver: rob 5 different bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies — each needs a plan, a crew approach and a clean getaway, and each escape counts separately. Do them one at a time and bank the getaway before starting the next; a failed escape means that vault does not count, so a fast car and a route you have driven before are worth more than a bigger cut.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes around the city: intercept one, crack it open, take the cash and escape before the police close in. The robbery itself is the easy half — the escape is the trophy. Have your getaway car facing the right way before you start, and take the first turn away from the truck's route so the responding units go the wrong way.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida is split into 52 named areas and you must set foot in every one. The map fills in as you travel, so this is a coverage sweep: drive the coast road, cross the interior, visit the islands and the small towns, and watch the area name change as you enter somewhere new. The in-game map shows which regions are still blank — finish with a deliberate tour of the ones you have never visited rather than hoping the story took you everywhere.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida and each runs illegal operations — stash houses, labs, storefronts. Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs. Gangs hold different territory, so this is a tour of the map's underworld: find a gang's operation in its own turf, hit it, and move on to the next gang's ground. The tracker counts the gangs, not the robberies, so a second hit on the same gang adds nothing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. The trophy is about the moment, not a challenge — sit, drink, watch the ocean. It is the sort of trophy that pops while you are doing something else entirely, so if you want it on purpose, head to the beachfront bars at sunset and order at the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front window and out the other side, in the classic style the description hints at. Pick a showroom with a long, clear run-up and a big glass front, get up to speed, and go straight through — the trophy is about the exit as much as the entry, so keep accelerating until you are clear of the building.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow through on the shot, as the description puts it. A full game at the alley counts toward the trophy, and the visit also covers one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Ten Pin, the melee drive-by trophy, is a separate stunt and does not need the alley at all.

sources.name: How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partner trophy whose trigger is still being pinned down by players: the working account in the guides is that it pops from a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd — a public, showy success together rather than a quiet one. Try the big partner activities (a loud robbery, a race win together, a stunt in a busy area) with your partner beside you. If it does not pop, it is one to revisit once the community settles the exact trigger; this guide will say so rather than invent one.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one: choices made across the game, for better or worse. Dialogue choices, mission approach choices and open-world decisions all feed the counter, so it climbs steadily through a normal playthrough — you do not need to hunt it. It is a long counter rather than a hard one: keep playing, keep choosing, and it pops in the late game. The tracker here counts toward 500 so you can see it coming.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — that is the whole trophy. The cleanest route is a short, repeatable activity: fail it once on purpose (miss the target, lose the race, flub the challenge), then win it on the immediate retry. The trophy watches for a failure followed by a success on the next attempt, so do the two back to back rather than hours apart.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The game's oddity trophy: witness something strange. Leonida hides scripted weird events — the kind of thing you stumble on while exploring rather than chasing a marker. Drive the back roads, visit the strange locations at odd hours, and when something unexplainable happens in front of you, the trophy pops. It cannot be forced on a schedule, so treat it as a bonus for exploring rather than a task to grind.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike someone with a melee weapon hard enough to bowl them over. Get a car up to a steady speed beside a pedestrian, lean out, and swing — the trophy is about the knockdown from the vehicle, not a normal on-foot melee hit. Pick a quiet street so the only complication is your aim, and keep the speed low enough to line the swing up.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money that has to be cleaned through your contacts: take the bills to a contact, launder them, and the clean cash counts toward $250,000. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so every laundering run adds up — it is a money counter, not a single job. Do it steadily as the bills come in from robberies and heists rather than saving it all for the end, and the trophy lands during the late game when the bigger hauls start flowing.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
How To Video Game — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A spending counter, not a shopping list: $100,000 spent across all shops in total. Weapons, clothes, car mods, food — every purchase counts, and it accumulates over the whole playthrough. Most players reach it naturally in the late game once the expensive purchases start; if you are close, the fastest top-up is vehicle modifications, which swallow thousands in a single visit.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida: buy all 8. Each one costs money and each one is a place to store vehicles, so buy them as your funds allow — the early ones are cheap, the late ones are not. The property menu shows which garages you own and which are still for sale, so check it before a buying trip and tick each purchase off here as you go.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles to it: register 10 different vehicles. Find a vehicle, open the app, register it, and move on to the next — any 10 distinct vehicles count, so use the variety already in your garage and on the street rather than hunting rare models. Ten registrations is quick once you know where the app lives in the phone menu.
